content: 第六关（后）

speaker: Skadi
content: Stop right there, Kal'tsit.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You're back.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   So, did you think things through, or...?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: So, did you think things through, or...?

raw: [name="Skadi"]   You wanted this, right? Take it.
speaker: Skadi
content: You wanted this, right? Take it.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You acted unilaterally, without permission.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   I do not interfere in the private affairs of our operators, nor do I ask them what they did in their free time - as long as they do not tarnish Rhodes Island's reputation.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I do not interfere in the private affairs of our operators, nor do I ask them what they did in their free time - as long as they do not tarnish Rhodes Island's reputation.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   I hope that whatever you did does not cost you your position in Rhodes Island, Skadi.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I hope that whatever you did does not cost you your position in Rhodes Island, Skadi.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   I'm not here for your snide remarks. I'm well aware of the rules. You needed something from me, and I need something from you.
speaker: Skadi
content: I'm not here for your snide remarks. I'm well aware of the rules. You needed something from me, and I need something from you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   What do you want from me then?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: What do you want from me then?

speaker: Skadi
content: Information.

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=-100, yFrom=0, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1.2, yScaleTo=1.2, duration=10, block=false)]
[name="Kal'tsit"]   Do you consider the information I have to be worth as little as this key?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Do you consider the information I have to be worth as little as this key?

raw: [name="Skadi"]   I can crush this stone in my palm in a heartbeat. I'm sure you don't want that.
speaker: Skadi
content: I can crush this stone in my palm in a heartbeat. I'm sure you don't want that.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   What I do know is that you went to Dewville in Kazimierz under pretenses of being on a mission, and even got into a conflict with a fellow operator.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: What I do know is that you went to Dewville in Kazimierz under pretenses of being on a mission, and even got into a conflict with a fellow operator.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   She kept quiet about what happened both there and at Rhodes Island for your sake. But in fact, I never assigned any such mission to you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: She kept quiet about what happened both there and at Rhodes Island for your sake. But in fact, I never assigned any such mission to you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Hmm? The core has already been filled with blood. This is not your blood. You wouldn't dare shed your own blood onto this soil.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Hmm? The core has already been filled with blood. This is not your blood. You wouldn't dare shed your own blood onto this soil.

speaker: Skadi
content: It's Grani's blood.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   You've already done something like this...
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You've already done something like this...

raw: [name="Skadi"]   I'll repay her. You don't need to remind me.
speaker: Skadi
content: I'll repay her. You don't need to remind me.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   I know this is what you need. A key, a core, a memory block... whatever it might be. I just have to obtain it.
speaker: Skadi
content: I know this is what you need. A key, a core, a memory block... whatever it might be. I just have to obtain it.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   'Skull,' 'Flamelung,' 'Yellow Smog'... I took them all out.
speaker: Skadi
content: 'Skull,' 'Flamelung,' 'Yellow Smog'... I took them all out.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   Otherwise, they surely would have taken this item. You wouldn't be able to barter with them, because you can't give them what they want.
speaker: Skadi
content: Otherwise, they surely would have taken this item. You wouldn't be able to barter with them, because you can't give them what they want.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   You need this 'stone,' and I need the information you have.
speaker: Skadi
content: You need this 'stone,' and I need the information you have.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   What a farce. I don't need any of these... components... to form the full picture.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: What a farce. I don't need any of these... components... to form the full picture.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   You're bound to Rhodes Island by contract, and you're bound to me likewise.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You're bound to Rhodes Island by contract, and you're bound to me likewise.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   You give me what I need, and I give you what you need.
speaker: Skadi
content: You give me what I need, and I give you what you need.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   I rarely see you this aggressive. Where's your usual laziness and snark?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I rarely see you this aggressive. Where's your usual laziness and snark?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   You want to know where Spectre's Originium nerve agent came from.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You want to know where Spectre's Originium nerve agent came from.

speaker: Skadi
content: ...How'd you find out?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Ægirian) 'Abyssal Hunters are bound by blood.'

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: There's nothing I don't know.

speaker: Skadi
content: ...Give me the info.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Very well. As long as you follow my every order, I might even decide to help you. The condition is, as long as you follow my every order.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Very well. As long as you follow my every order, I might even decide to help you. The condition is, as long as you follow my every order.

raw: [name="Skadi"]   I only follow those who are trustworthy.
speaker: Skadi
content: I only follow those who are trustworthy.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   I never go back on my word.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I never go back on my word.
